1.text: Isaka ashaje, amaso ye amaze kuba ibirorirori, ahamagara imfura ye Esawu ati “Mwana wanjye.” Aritaba ati “Karame.”

2.text: Aramubwira ati “Dore ndi umusaza, sinzi igihe nzapfira.

3.text: None ndakwinginze, enda ibyo uhigisha, ikirimba cyawe n'umuheto wawe, ujye mu ishyamba umpigireyo umuhigo,

4.text: untekere inyama ziryoshye nk'izo nkunda, uzinzanire nzirye mbone kuguhesha umugisha ntarapfa.”

5.text: Rebeka yumva Isaka abwira umwana we Esawu. Esawu ajya mu ishyamba guhiga, ngo ahigurire se umuhigo.

6.text: Rebeka abwira Yakobo umwana we ati “Numvise so abwira Esawu mwene so ati

7.text: ‘Mpigurira umuhigo, untekere inyama ziryoshye nzirye, nguheshereze umugisha mu maso y'Uwiteka ntarapfa.’

8.text: Nuko none mwana wanjye, wumvire ibyo ngiye kugutegeka.

9.text: Jya mu mukumbi unzanire abana b'ihene beza babiri, nanjye ndabatekera so babe inyama ziryoshye zimeze nk'izo akunda,

10.text: nawe uzishyīre so azirye, aguheshe umugisha atarapfa.”

11.text: Yakobo asubiza Rebeka nyina ati “Dore Esawu mukuru wanjye ni cyoya, jyeweho umubiri wanjye ni umurembe.

12.text: Ahari data yankorakora, akamenya ko ndi umuriganya, nkizanira umuvumo mu cyimbo cy'umugisha.”

13.text: Nyina aramubwira ati “Mwana wanjye umuvumo wawe abe ari jye ubaho, nyumvira gusa ugende uzinzanire.”

14.text: Aragenda arazizana aziha nyina, nyina ateka inyama ziryoshye nk'izo se akunda.

15.text: Rebeka yenda imyambaro myiza ya Esawu imfura ye, iyo yari afite mu nzu, ayambika Yakobo umuhererezi.

16.text: Kandi ashyira impu z'abo bana b'ihene ku bikonjo bye no ku ijosi rye, aharembekereye.

17.text: Aha umwana we Yakobo za nyama ziryoshye yatetse n'umutsima yavuze.

18.text: Ajya aho se ari aramuhamagara ati “Data.” Aritaba ati “Ndakwitaba. Uri nde mwana wanjye?”

19.text: Yakobo asubiza se ati “Ndi imfura yawe Esawu, nkoze ibyo wantegetse. Ndakwinginze, byuka urye ku muhigo wanjye, kugira ngo umpeshe umugisha.”

20.text: Isaka abaza umwana we ati “Ni iki kiwukubonesheje vuba utyo, mwana wanjye?”Aramusubiza ati “Ni uko Uwiteka Imana yawe impaye ishya.”

21.text: Isaka abwira Yakobo ati “Mwana wanjye, igira hino ndakwinginze, ngukorakore, menye yuko uri umwana wanjye Esawu koko, cyangwa ko utari we.”

22.text: Yakobo yegera Isaka se, aramukorakora aravuga ati “Ijwi ni irya Yakobo, ariko ibikonjo ni ibya Esawu.”

23.text: Ntiyamenya uwo ari we, kuko ibikonjo bye biriho ubwoya nk'ibya mukuru we Esawu, nuko amuhesha umugisha.

24.text: Aramubaza ati “Uri umwana wanjye Esawu koko?”Aramusubiza ati “Ndi we.”

25.text: Aramubwira ati “Wunyegereze, nanjye ndye ku muhigo w'umwana wanjye, kugira ngo nguheshe umugisha.” Arawumwegereza ararya, amuzanira vino, ashozaho.

26.text: Se Isaka aramubwira ati “Mwana wanjye, nyegera unsome.”

27.text: Aramwegera, aramusoma, yumva impumuro y'imyambaro ye, amuhesha umugisha ati“Impumuro y'umwana wanjye,Imeze nk'iy'umurima UwitekaYahaye umugisha.

28.text: Nuko Imana iguhe ku kime kiva mu ijuru,No ku mwero w'ubutaka,N'imyaka y'impeke myinshi,Na vino nyinshi.

29.text: Amoko agukorere,Amahanga akwikubite imbere,Utware bene so,Bene nyoko bakwikubite imbere.Uzakuvuma wese avumwe,Uzakwifuriza umugisha wese awuhabwe.”

30.text: Isaka arangije guhesha Yakobo umugisha, Yakobo akiva mu maso ya Isaka se, Esawu mukuru we arahīguka.

31.text: Na we ateka inyama ziryoshye azizanira se, abwira se ati “Data, byuka urye ku muhigo w'umwana wawe, kugira ngo umpeshe umugisha.”

32.text: Isaka se aramubaza ati “Uri nde?”Aramusubiza ati “Ndi umwana wawe w'imfura Esawu.”

33.text: Isaka ahinda umushyitsi mwinshi cyane ati “Ni nde wahize umuhigo akawunzanira, nkaba nariye kuri byose utaraza, nkamuhesha umugisha? Kandi koko azanawuhabwa.”

34.text: Esawu yumvise amagambo ya se, aboroga umuborogo mwinshi w'umunyamubabaro abwira se ati “Jye nanjye mpesha umugisha, data wambyaye.”

35.text: Aramusubiza ati “Murumuna wawe yazanye uburiganya, yiba umugisha wawe.”

36.text: Aramubwira ati “Yakobo ni Yakobo koko, izina ni ryo muntu. Ubu ni ubwa kabiri andiganya, yankuyeho ubutware dore none ankuyeho n'umugisha.” Arongera aramubaza ati “Nta mugisha wansigiye?”

37.text: Isaka asubiza Esawu ati “Dore namuhaye kugutwara, na bene se bose nabamuhaye kuba abagaragu be, kandi namugaburiye vino n'imyaka y'impeke. Nagukorera iki, mwana wanjye?”

38.text: Esawu abaza se ati “Nta mugisha n'umwe usigiranye data? Jye nanjye mpesha umugisha, data.” Esawu araturika ararira.

39.text: Isaka se aramusubiza ati“Ubuturo bwawe buzaba kure y'umwero w'ubutaka,Buzaba kure y'ikime kiva mu ijuru.

40.text: Inkota yawe ni yo izakubeshaho,Kandi uzakorera murumuna waweKandi nugoma uzikuraho uburetwa yagushyizeho.”

41.text: Esawu yangira Yakobo umugisha se yamuhesheje. Esawu aribwira ati “Iminsi yo kwiraburira data iri bugufi, ni bwo nzica murumuna wanjye Yakobo.”

42.text: Babwira Rebeka amagambo ya Esawu imfura ye, atumira Yakobo umuhererezi aramubwira ati “Dore mukuru wawe Esawu agiye kwimarisha agahinda wamuteye kukwica.

43.text: Nuko rero mwana wanjye nyumvira, haguruka uhungire i Harani kwa Labani musaza wanjye,

44.text: umarane na we iminsi itari myinshi, ugeze aho uburakari bwa mukuru wawe buzashirira,

45.text: ugeze aho inzika ya mukuru wawe izakuviraho akibagirwa ibyo wamugiriye, maze nzabona kugutumira ugaruke. Ni iki cyatuma mbapfushiriza rimwe mwembi?”

46.text: Rebeka abwira Isaka ati “Ubugingo bwanjye burambiwe ba Bahetikazi. Yakobo yarongora Umuhetikazi nka ba bandi, ubugingo bwanjye bwamarira iki?”
